_method: Labelled by reading the source at the pinned commit. Each entry names the specific call that justifies it. `true` means the scanner should report it; `false` means reporting it is a false positive.

true.why: execute_with_pty() reaches os.execvp('/bin/sh', ...) with a model-controlled command. The canonical PTY shell tool.
exec(code, namespace) on a model-supplied `code` string. The canonical REPL tool.
_read_crontab() calls subprocess.run(['crontab', ...]); the tool schedules arbitrary commands.
focus_application() calls subprocess.run(['osascript', ...]) with model-influenced input.

subprocess.run(['say', text]) with model-controlled text. argv[0] is constant, so this is execution reachability rather than command injection -- reported because the claim is 'reaches execution with no decision', which is true.
time_machine_view() calls subprocess.check_output(['git', ...]). Same shape as speak: constant argv[0], model-influenced arguments.
